description:
C3 2023 WINTER SUBMISSION

One of the various backgrounds seen in the Skeleton Cave from Castlevania: Harmony of Dissonance. It depicts the Giant Ghost sub-boss seen in the Castlevania: Rondo of Blood. A great fit for haunted caves, in general.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
